title: Not enough filling
text:
Not enough filling. In spite of the condescending marketing enclosure, the problem is not that the customer is too stupid to understand how vacuum packed pillows work, but in fact that the pillows are understuffed. I solved this by taking filling out of a different pillow and adding it to these overpriced and understuffed pillows to get the correct amount of plumpness and support. And yes, I waited a few days for them to expand to their maximum before doing so.

Having added extra filling myself, these inserts are now pretty good. The zipper is a nice feature.
